I confirmed this with a variant (TS0 = rare all-single, TS1–3 = benzene): the buggy code reported the rare all-single ring as the representative; after the fix it correctly reports benzene.

**Fix** (`source/reacnetgenerator/_mergeiso.py:41-52`): moved the frequency comparison into the merge branch and track `_oldfreq` so the highest-frequency isomer's bond record becomes the representative. Ties keep the first-in-sort isomer (strict `>`).
